novelty_flags.label: thm:causal-transfer / related_work
novelty_flags.one_line: The direct count-DAG comparison omits Gao, Cai, and Hara (2026), “Causal DAG Identification for Count Data via Poisson Thinning Structural Equation Models,” a closer count-valued DAG-identification comparator than the current generic CPCM-only discussion.

soundness_flags.label: def:grid-criterion / thm:finite-grid-existence
soundness_flags.one_line: For an allowed singleton candidate set, the minimum defining Γ_T is over an empty set, and μ_T is not mathematically defined because its projected map, chart domains, and strong-monotonicity convention are unspecified.

soundness_flags.label: def:certificate-procedure / thm:certificate-soundness-complexity
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed finite procedure must construct the rational projections and chart cover used by μ_T, but neither is an input nor is their construction and verification rule specified.

soundness_flags.label: oeq:three-node-benchmark
soundness_flags.one_line: The alleged fixed benchmark does not fix the full Xi: W, ρ, r_id, R, tail/Taylor/subdivision controls, N_max, and the sole permitted refinement are unspecified, so certification is not a determinate question.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper assumes spatial and temporal independence of link delays and constructs an overdetermined linear system for link cumulant-generating functions from end-to-end sums.
Consequence 6 gives the Poisson bivariate nonidentifiability characterization; Definition 10 defines pairwise identifiability and Lemma 11 identifies the multivariate DAG from the joint law under it.
The paper studies recoverability under aggregation and states that the examined consistency properties require linear aggregation coupled with affine structural equations.

source_verification_receipts.locator: title matter and introductory verification-methods discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article develops rigorous verification methods using floating-point arithmetic.
The paper covers finite and continuum moment conditions and states consistency and asymptotic normality of its estimator.
Taylor models provide rigorous enclosures and are used in branch-and-bound rigorous global search.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define Γ_T for singleton graph sets and give a formal definition of μ_T, including the projected map, chart domains, monotonicity inequality, rational-cover construction, and its finite certificate checks.

Make the three-node OEQ executable by publishing one complete rational Xi and the exact one-step refinement rule, including W, ρ, r_id, truncation and interval controls, N_max, and arithmetic precision policy.
Add Gao–Cai–Hara (2026) to related work and state precisely why Poisson-thinning direct-law identification neither subsumes nor yields recovery through known multi-composition pools.

Sharpen the certificate theorem with an explicit sound decision predicate for labeled pooled-law graph-and-effect identification, rather than leaving that conclusion split between the certificate theorem and a supporting lemma.

recommended_next_step: Revise the undefined certificate/grid objects and complete the synthetic input, then rerun novelty review with the added count-DAG comparator.
